purpose: Make the comparison dimensions and their evaluation questions easier to scan than prose alone.
alt: Six overlapping needs, with a different test of value for each.. Learn: Practice a skill with feedback and progression. Examples: Speak · Praktika. Test: Can the user do something better without the app? Create: Turn an idea into something worth editing and sharing. Examples: Suno · Krea. Test: How many outputs become finished work? Connect: Enjoy an ongoing conversational relationship. Examples: Tolan. Test: Does the experience support life beyond the conversation? Understand: Transform material into a useful explanation or personal work. Examples: ListenHub · YouMind. Test: Is the result faithful, and does understanding improve? Organize: Reduce the work of coordinating household life. Examples: Ohai. Test: Is less checking and correction needed overall? Decide: Explore choices that fit preferences and constraints. Examples: Mindtrip · Daydream. Test: Does the final choice serve the user, not only the seller?
caption: Figure 1. Consumer needs and value tests. Author’s synthesis.
